name: Go + Gin
description: Idiomatic Go conventions for Gin-based REST APIs

rules.title: Separate handler from business logic
rules.content: Gin handlers must only parse input and call service functions. Keep all business logic in service structs under internal/service/.

rules.title: Wrap errors with context
rules.content: Always use fmt.Errorf("package: action: %w", err) when returning errors. Never discard errors silently.

rules.title: Use filepath.Join for paths
rules.content: Never concatenate file paths with +. Always use filepath.Join() to ensure cross-platform compatibility.

rules.title: Table-driven tests
rules.content: Prefer table-driven tests using []struct{ name, input, expected }. Use t.Run() for subtests. Aim for >80% coverage on internal/ packages.

rules.title: Exported functions need godoc
rules.content: Every exported function, type, and constant must have a godoc comment starting with the name of the symbol.

rules.title: Validate all external input
rules.content: Use binding tags or explicit validation for all request structs. Return 400 with descriptive message for invalid input, never 500.
